# generated/coverletter — auto-generated cover letters

The automaton writes per-application cover letters here (one `.txt` per job,
named `cover-<company>-<timestamp>.txt`) when cover-letter generation is
enabled. Files are **git-ignored** (may contain personal data); this folder and
README are kept so a fresh clone has the structure.

See `docs/configuration.md` and `linkedin_easy_apply/orchestrator.py`
(`_COVER_DIR`) for where this path is wired.
